en: ReDeck is a research framework for slide generation and refinement.
tts_en: Re Deck is a research framework for slide generation and refinement.
instruct: Speak as a Microsoft Research presenter: measured, precise, accessible, and quietly confident. Avoid promotional or theatrical delivery.
Introduce the complexity of slides in a measured, accessible research presentation tone.

en: AI drafts have many issues, so refinement is essential.
instruct: Continue smoothly, with restrained emphasis on why refinement is necessary.

en: If observations are too late or too sparse, the spatial effect of each edit remains unknown.
instruct: Explain the motivation analytically, emphasizing observation timing, frequency, and spatial attribution rather than implementation details.

en: ReDeck observes the slide after every atomic edit.
tts_en: Re Deck observes the slide after every atomic edit.
instruct: Introduce the method principle with calm confidence, stressing observation after each edit.

en: Each observation reveals how that edit changed the real spatial state.
instruct: Explain the insight precisely but accessibly, with emphasis on the edit's observable spatial consequence.

en: That evidence grounds the next action.
instruct: Use a concise connective delivery, emphasizing evidence rather than process.

en: The agent can keep, revise, or roll back the edit, then validate before submission.
instruct: Explain the evidence-based choices and final validation rule with measured clarity.

en: The case studies show complete repair traces from accepted runs.
instruct: Introduce the case studies as evidence from real accepted runs, without promotional emphasis.

en: When a regression appears, the agent returns to the last valid state and tries another repair.
instruct: Explain rollback as evidence-guided recovery in an analytical tone.

en: Step-level observations handle local spatial effects; the turn-level critic tracks broader issues.
instruct: Explain the separated responsibilities of the two feedback levels clearly and without jargon-heavy delivery.

en: Together, they improve layout while preserving the source meaning.
instruct: Conclude the method with calm certainty, emphasizing complementarity.

en: DeckQuiz scores fidelity, spatial quality, aesthetics, and design.
tts_en: Deck Quiz scores fidelity, spatial quality, aesthetics, and design.
instruct: Introduce component-level evaluation formally and clearly.

en: ReDeck improves all four. Local and global feedback work together.
tts_en: Re Deck improves all four. Local and global feedback work together.
instruct: Report the result and ablation insight with measured confidence, not excitement.

en: ReDeck is open source, with code, benchmarks, and repair examples.
tts_en: Re Deck is open source, with code, benchmarks, and repair examples.
instruct: Close as a research project invitation: restrained, professional, and informative.
